reply_text:
I’d block on **one issue** in `3ebff74`:

**[P1] Paid-plan quotas become zero — `src/plans.js:11`.**  
`entry.quotaKiB << 10` uses JavaScript’s 32-bit bitwise conversion. Both `team` (200 GiB) and `archive` (2 TiB) evaluate to **0 bytes**, so even a 1-byte upload to an empty paid account is rejected as “over quota.” I reproduced this for both plans.

Use arithmetic multiplication by `1024` instead, and add quota/upload tests for both paid plans before merging.

All four existing tests pass; they don’t cover paid plans. No code changed.
